name: A Knight's Myosotis
source:
"Protecting the crown and following its orders is the only reason you were born."

Since the new king's rise to power, the kingdom's guards and knights have been viewed with fear by the people.

But one of those knights, Einar, since birth, being a knight has been his sole destiny, thanks to the lineage into which he was born. His routine life behind the palace walls will soon change once he encounters a wolf who will bring light to his routine life.

[From [url=https://wolfrang-stromhills.itch.io/a-knights-myosotis]Itch.io[/url]]
